newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse seen firm despite upcoming supply.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse seen firm despite upcoming supply.

text.p: Belgian shares rose in early Monday trade, lifted by exporters, which benefitted from the French Left's election victory.
Dealers said that the future euro currency could weaken if the French socialists would support entry of the Italian lira and the Spanish peseta.
"(French socialist party leader Lionel) Jospin wants Italy and Spain in EMU, this will lead to a weakening of the euro against the dollar, which will help our exporting companies," one dealer said.
The dollar stood at 35.44 to the franc, from 35.14 Friday.
